title: Act: Run art:generate to emit item PNGs and manifest entries
summary: Regenerate assets so the six item icons and manifest entries are committed
description: With ITEM_SOURCES in ART_SOURCES, run the existing art:generate script so mergeManifest adds six item/ entries and writes the PNGs. No generator code change is needed.
acceptance_criteria: manifest.json has six item/ entries of type image with 16x16 dimensions.
technical_constraints: Use npm run art:generate; deterministic output.
definition_of_done: git diff shows only new item files and manifest additions.

steps.lines: after the room/ entries in assets
steps.action: Run npm run art:generate in game/frontend; it writes the six PNGs and appends item/old-key, item/note, item/book, item/coin, item/flashlight and item/photo entries with type image and dimensions {width:16,height:16}. Do not edit the JSON by hand.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npm run art:generate && git status --short ../public
steps.expected: Six new PNGs under items/ and a manifest diff with only six added entries.
